question: Which scheme–ministry pairing is correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-NAM – Ministry of Agriculture**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​PM-AASHA (Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan):** This scheme is under the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare**. It aims to ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce through mechanisms like Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS). Hence, **statement 1 is incorrect.**
 
• **e-NAM (National Agriculture Market):** This is an initiative of the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare**. It is an online platform that facilitates better price discovery for farmers by connecting buyers and sellers across the country. Hence, **statement 2 is correct.**
 
• **PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana):** This scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Jal Shakti (formerly Ministry of Water Resources)**. It focuses on irrigation development and improving water use efficiency under the motto “Har Khet Ko Pani” (water to every field). Hence, **statement 3 is incorrect.**
 
• **RODTEP (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products):** This scheme is under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, not the Ministry of Finance. It ensures reimbursement of embedded taxes and duties to exporters, making Indian products globally competitive. Hence, **statement 4 is incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Detailed Information about PMKSY:**

 
 
• **PMKSY** was launched in **2015** to achieve the vision of “Per Drop More Crop.”
 
• It aims to provide **irrigation facilities to every farm**, ensuring optimal use of water resources and promoting sustainable agriculture.
 
• Major components include **Accelerated Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP), Har Khet Ko Pani, Per Drop More Crop,** and watershed development.
 
• It is implemented by the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** in coordination with the **Ministry of Agriculture** and state governments.
 
 
 
• **Details of Other Schemes:**
 
 
• **PM-AASHA:** Introduced in **2018**, it ensures farmers get the **Minimum Support Price (MSP)** for their crops and aims to reduce agricultural distress.
 
• **e-NAM:** Launched in **2016**, it connects **585 Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs)** across the country, improving market access for farmers.
 
• **RODTEP:** Introduced in **2021**, it replaced the **MEIS (Merchandise Exports from India Scheme)** to comply with WTO norms and enhance export competitiveness.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **PMKSY Key Facts:**

 
 
• The **Accelerated Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP)** under PMKSY focuses on completing long-pending irrigation projects.
 
• The **Per Drop More Crop** component promotes micro-irrigation techniques like **drip and sprinkler irrigation**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of RODTEP:**
 
 
• RODTEP ensures exporters get refunds for **embedded taxes and duties** that were not refunded earlier, such as **VAT on fuel**.
 
• It covers sectors like agriculture, textiles, chemicals, and more, making Indian goods more competitive.
